findings.title: Unbounded string parameter
findings.description: Parameter 'source_timezone' accepts a string with no maximum length, enum, or pattern. It can carry arbitrarily large or arbitrary content into the tool - including flood payloads and injection strings.
findings.remediation: Constrain 'source_timezone' with maxLength and/or a pattern or enum.
